text:
maria: Quick Q — found debug dumps in s3://redwood-debug/session-logs/ that include short-lived session tokens in plain text. Do we redact before upload or just TTL/delete? Also what retention window should we enforce for these debug dumps? cc @alex

security-bot: Automated scan: potential secret exposure detected in 3 objects under /session-logs/. See incident ticket set up below.

raj: These came from the session-replay dev tool. Default retention on that prefix was 90d I think. Tokens themselves are 1h ephemeral, but still they look like secrets. Short term: redact or shorten TTL. Long term: fix at source.

olivia: Policy reminder — any secrets (tokens, api keys, cookies) must be redacted before shipping logs. We can also tighten lifecycle on debug prefixes. Current lifecycle rule for /session-logs/ is 90d; we can change to 7d for debug dumps. @dylan can you make a quick lifecycle update for this prefix?

dylan: I can modify the lifecycle rule but need a small infra PR and config change. I'll open PR now and roll to staging first. Note: some older objects are gzipped; redaction job needs to handle compressed blobs.

alex: From privacy side: preference is redaction at source. Short TTL as a fallback is fine for emergency. Approving temporary 7d TTL for the prefix, but we need: 1) rotate any tokens if they could be used, 2) postmortem + remediation plan, 3) infra change tracked in PR. Maria, are any objects tied to real customer accounts?

maria: These are internal/test accounts (no customer PII), but the tool uses a service token for replay capture — we should rotate that. I'll open a rotation ticket.

raj: Quick hack suggestion: we can run a redaction pass that replaces token values with `<REDACTED>` using s3 copy with transform. Example log line: `session_id=abc123 user=alice token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni... exp=17123456`

olivia: Regex we typically use: `token=[A-Za-z0-9\-_.]{20,}` (apply carefully). For compressed files, decompress, redact, recompress, rewrite. I'll pair with @dylan on the job.

dylan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2345 — changes lifecycle for /session-logs/debug/ to 7d in staging, adds permission to run redaction job. Will request review from @olivia and @alex.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026 created for secret exposure scan. Assigned to eng-sre and security.

alex: Emergency TTL approved. Please ensure we rotate the service token and run the redaction job before PR merge. Also add a short runbook for future occurrences.

maria: Thanks — I'll file token rotation ticket and run the redaction script with olivia/dylan tomorrow morning. Will post summary + links here when done. :thumbsup:
